fuse_conv_bn_eval: fuse a convolutional module and a BatchNorm module into a single convolutional module in eval mode
fuse_conv_bn_weights: fuse convolutional weights and biases with BatchNorm running statistics into new fused parameters
fuse_linear_bn_eval: fuse a linear module and a BatchNorm module into a single linear module in eval mode
fuse_linear_bn_weights: fuse linear weights and biases with BatchNorm running statistics into new fused parameters
optimize_inference_model: optimize a PyTorch model by fusing convolutional or linear layers with BatchNorm for faster inference
